\title{Field-free switching of a noncollinear antiferromagnet}
\begin{abstract}
Spin-orbit torque reverses the octupole order of a single-domain Mn3Sn film.
This study is limited to a single-domain model.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}
A key limitation of existing switching schemes is the need for a bias field~\cite{a}.
Here we show that tilting the kagome plane removes it.

\section{Results}
Reversal takes 0.3 ns (Fig.~\ref{fig:1}).
Thermal fluctuations were not included in these simulations.

\begin{figure}
\caption{Reversal time against tilt angle. Domain walls were not considered.}
\label{fig:1}
\end{figure}

\section{Conclusion}
Tilting the kagome plane enables field-free switching. A limitation of our model is the absence of domain walls.

\section*{Methods}
Thermal fluctuations are not included in the model.
